summary: EVALUATOR returned rework with 3 typed finding(s).
findings: The evaluated implementation can combine HEAD, status, and index observations from different repository states because all three Git commands run concurrently and their results are materialized as one snapshot.

The added tests prove command scheduling and stable-repository parity only; they do not exercise repository mutation between concurrent HEAD, status, index, and path-fingerprint observations.
missing_tests: A deterministic mutation-barrier test that changes HEAD/index/worktree state between the concurrent Git observations and proves the implementation either retries, rejects the observation, or returns one coherent state.
Current-SHA execution records for bun run ci:contract, bun run test:critical, and bun run typecheck.

Stable-repository parity is assumed to generalize to concurrent Git mutation.
Earlier no-go verification is assumed to remain applicable after production source and tests changed.
